calls.reason: The workflow RAG study shows retrieval reduces hallucination, but Mindful-RAG finds models still fail when they have the needed facts. Neither isolates the causal mechanism Marcus proposes.
Anthropic's report confirms the blazer claim and the money-losing pricing. But Claudius recovered, and Anthropic says the cause is unclear, so the report does not show it had no model at all.

Llama 3's documentation describes a standard transformer with no designed store of entity facts, and Anthropic admits it does not understand most of what models do. The binding-ID work finds learned mechanisms, not explicit models.
Vafa et al. find incoherent implicit world models, but Li et al. and Karvonen show interpretable state tracking in narrower settings. With no adequacy threshold, the evidence is mixed.
Stockfish has used NNUE neural evaluation by default since September 2020, feeding an alpha-beta search, and 17.1's code still does. It won the TCEC Season 27 superfinal in January 2025.

The chess and program-semantics studies show causally used world representations emerging from prediction in specialized models, while Vafa et al. find incoherent maps. The evidence is mixed and does not cover general-purpose LLMs.
